slides.texte_overlay:
7 ordinary habits that make
you magnetic in your 20s
Making your bed every morning. Thirty seconds, every single day. It sets the tone of a man who takes care of himself, and it's the first win of your day.
Showing up five minutes early. To work, to dates, to the gym. Reliability is rare in your 20s, and people are naturally drawn to someone they can count on.
Training your body three times a week. No extreme program, just consistency. Strength and energy show in how you walk, stand and talk to people every single day.
Keeping in touch with old friends. A message, a call, a visit. A man surrounded by long friendships is a man people trust and genuinely want to be around.
Before: scrolling every evening. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a curious mind that makes every conversation more interesting.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: scrolling every evening. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Now every conversation is more interesting.

slides.texte_overlay: Taking care of your skin. Wash your face, use moisturiser, wear sunscreen. Simple habits in your 20s pay off for decades, and people notice a healthy face.
Saying thank you often. To the barista, the bus driver, your colleagues. Gratitude makes you warm and easy to be around, and that's what magnetic really means.
